_readme: Copy to config/brainiac_wizard_last.json — the wizard writes this file. Pool id is never stored.

_field_descriptions.pool_id: Raydium CLMM pool address. Not saved — always prompts ENTER_POOL_ADDRESS_HERE.
_field_descriptions.deposit_usd: USD notional for the open (USDC on USDC pools; converted to SOL on SOL pools).
_field_descriptions.fund_non_pay_fraction: Pay→alt fund fraction (default 0.35 on deposits under $3).
_field_descriptions.wide_width_pct: Total band width % for Brainiac skew grid (default 80).
_field_descriptions.min_in_range_factor: Block open if pretrade in-range factor is below this (default 0.55); 0 = off.
_field_descriptions.skip_fund_swap: Skip pay→non-pay funding when alt is already in wallet (default yes).
_field_descriptions.skip_settle_after: Skip post-open sweep of junk to pay-type.
_field_descriptions.use_auto_live_policy: SUPER-BRAINIAC auto policy after pool id entered.
_field_descriptions.dry_run_preview_only: Plan + pretrade only; no on-chain txs.
